wifi.boot_policy: attempt primary known network automatically without user interaction
wifi.credential_policy: embed the primary credential in the compiled firmware image via a private build secret; never serialize the password into this registry or public source
wifi.fallback: if ToyCastle is unavailable, expose an on-device Wi-Fi scan, network picker and password entry UI
wifi.fallback_persistence: save successful fallback credentials in NVS and prefer ToyCastle again when it becomes available
wifi.street_use_case: allow a phone hotspot or other temporary network to be selected directly on Cardputer ADV

radio_audio_lease.rule: RADIO_R owns the speaker/audio path from mode entry until mode exit, not merely while MP3 engineRunning is true
radio_audio_lease.brainwave_on_entry: silence BrainWave immediately before catalogue/network/player work begins
radio_audio_lease.brainwave_restore: restore the pre-radio BrainWave enabled state only after the Radio foreground lease is released
radio_audio_lease.hard_mute: absolute; radio and BrainWave both remain silent
radio_audio_lease.radio_engine: ESP8266Audio MP3 path through M5Cardputer Speaker with bounded buffering

input.legacy_wasd: not canonical; may remain only as optional compatibility if it does not conflict with HOME mode shortcuts
escape_home: top G0 / BtnA hardware HOME semantic

game.simulation_boundary: game state is FICTION/SIMULATION and must never feed OBSERVED_REAL, anomaly evidence or M2R truth

adopt: role-readable enemy morphology rather than generic circles
spatially bounded effects suitable for ESP32-S3
do_not_adopt: zero-player two-colony gameplay as the foreground game

game.background_goal: dense but legible animated pixel biome that remains subordinate to enemies/player/HUD and preserves ADV frame budget

brainwave.game: silent for the entire ALIEN_SURVIVAL_A foreground lease
brainwave.radio: silent for the entire RADIO_R foreground lease
brainwave.home_and_nonexclusive_modes: allowed subject to hardMute/masterVolume and existing policy

binary_release_contract.source_credentials: private CI/build secret injected into generated ADV_Elite_local_config.h before compile
binary_release_contract.hardware_validation: required after first real Cardputer ADV flash; compile success alone is not hardware proof

epistemic_note: The three supplied game files are design/code donors. Their rendering and ecosystem mechanics support the visual transplant, but they do not by themselves establish Cardputer ADV runtime performance; that remains a hardware measurement gate.
